items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: My mother was a pianist, right. She was always preparing for a concert that never happened.

ctx.x: My mother was a pianist, right. She was always preparing for a concert that never happened. She really didn't intend to have a concert, but she trained as if she would have. She practiced faithfully everyday, she would practice the same music on each day and we would have the same food--this is funny, because when I'd come home from school and I'd hear my mother practicing, I would know what I was going to have for lunch, according to what she was playing.
That lead to a well ordered life.
